description:
About Us

Axelera AI builds the most power-efficient AI inference hardware and software in the market, from the edge to the data center. Founded in 2021 and headquartered at High Tech Campus Eindhoven, we design AI processors on our Digital In-Memory Computing architecture, including the Metis platform and the Europa AIPU for multi-user generative AI and computer vision.

We have grown from the founding employees to employees across 20 countries, and over 750 customers. In February 2026 we raised more than $250 million, the largest investment ever in an EU-based AI semiconductor company, bringing total funding past $450 million. Our customers span physical and edge AI: defense and public safety, industrial manufacturing, retail, robotics, agritech and security, to AI Factories and enterprise AI customers looking to control their own infrastructure and costs.

Position Overview

We are hiring a Vice President of Marketing to run the global marketing engine that turns our technology lead into market leadership. You will report to our CMO and General Manager of the Americas as her senior operating partner. She sets marketing strategy, positioning and budget, and directly leads developer relations, partnerships and technical sales development. You turn that strategy into one global plan and lead the team that delivers it: corporate communications, content, digital marketing, events and our webstore. We plan together, share one dashboard, and keep decisions close to the people doing the work.

You will join a highly functional team that has already grown Axelera AI’s engagement significantly across press, digital, events, partners and our developer community. This is not a rebuild. We want a leader who earns the team’s trust, builds on what got us here, and pushes it further: sharper storytelling, more scale from digital, tighter integration across channels and clearer measurable impact. Ideally, you have been inside a deep tech company as it grew from a small team into a scaled organization, and you know which processes, tools and hires matter at each stage.

What you’ll do:

Communications and narrative

  • Own the global corporate narrative and messaging architecture, translating deeply technical differentiation into clear, consistent stories for developers, engineers, enterprise buyers, partners, analysts, investors and policymakers across press, web, sales, events, investor and recruiting content.

  • Lead global PR and media relations across Europe, North America and Asia with agencies in each region, and run executive communications and thought leadership for the CEO and leadership team: keynotes, bylines, interviews and podcasts.

  • Manage high-stakes announcements end to end: product disclosures, partnerships, customer wins, leadership changes, and issues and crisis communications.

  • Build internal communications that keep a fast-growing, multi-country workforce aligned on strategy and milestones.

Digital marketing

  • Own the global digital strategy and channel mix (website and webstore, SEO, paid search and social, email, marketing automation and content syndication), running the website and webstore as pipeline and conversion assets.

  • Run demand generation and account-based programs with sales, from campaign design to lead scoring, nurture and handoff.

  • Own the marketing technology stack (HubSpot, Salesforce integration, analytics) and data quality, with dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue for the CMO and executive team.

Integrated marketing communications

  • Plan and run integrated campaigns for launches and key moments, with PR, digital, content, social, events, partner and developer community channels working off one plan and adapted for EMEA, the Americas and APAC.

  • Run the global content engine: editorial calendar, technical content, case studies, video, social and sales enablement assets.

  • Steward the brand and visual identity across regions, partners and co-marketing.

Team, scale and operations

  • Lead an established, high-performing team spanning communications, content, digital, events and marketing operations, with direct reports in several countries. Learn what is working first, protect the momentum, and coach the team to its next level.

  • Strengthen the operating rhythm (annual and quarterly planning, budgets, campaign briefs, launch playbooks, retrospectives and KPIs) so the team ships consistently while the company changes around it.

What you bring:

  • 12+ years in B2B technology marketing, including 5+ years leading teams, in semiconductors, AI, computing infrastructure or another deep tech field.

  • A communications foundation: you have led PR, media relations and executive communications, ideally having started your career in communications, journalism or a PR agency.

  • Native or native-level English, with exceptional writing and speaking skills. You can draft a press release, edit a CEO keynote and brief a journalist in the same afternoon.

  • Hands-on digital marketing leadership: you have owned web, SEO, paid media, marketing automation and demand generation, and you can show the pipeline results.

  • Experience running integrated campaigns and major launches across several regions at once.

  • A track record of helping a deep tech company scale from an early-stage team to a large, multi-country organization, and of maturing the marketing function, processes and team as it grew. You know how to step into a strong team that is already delivering, build on its work, and help it reach the next level.

  • Experience managing agencies and distributed teams across European and North American markets.

  • Data-driven judgment: comfortable with HubSpot or similar automation, CRM data and attribution, and with defending budget decisions on ROI.

  • The ability to learn complex technology quickly and explain it accurately without overstating claims.

  • Comfort working strategically and hands-on in the same week, in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift.

Location

We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to: 

  • Work from one of our Axelera AI offices (Bristol in the United Kingdom, Amsterdam and Eindhoven in the Netherlands) if you're already based in the vicinity. 

  • Work fully remotely from the UK or the Netherlands. 

What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. If you have been approached by someone on our behalf and want to confirm it’s legitimate, please contact us directly at careers@axelera.ai.
